title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
author: Eleftherios Tzanis, Michail E. Klontzas
description: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. summary: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step.
takeaways: A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them.

On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%).
Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step.
